forma_de_gobierno.evidencia: Authority rests in the assembly. ... Coordinator, elected monthly, removable by absolute majority, convenes meetings, assigns unfilled tasks, records work publicly

regla_de_decision.evidencia: ordinary decisions are approved by absolute majority (at least 4 of the 7 participants in favor). Decisions concerning the custody, reserve and allocation policy of the boat or the medicines require a qualified majority of at least 5 of 7.

regimen_de_propiedad.evidencia: land, water, trees, animals, mines and the river are common property; nobody may appropriate them. ... Tools and rescued goods are common; ... Personal effects are private.

sistema_economico.evidencia: Everyone contributes work according to capacity and receives a full basic ration; surplus is distributed proportionally to work.

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: Disputes: parties first seek agreement with Party 5 mediating within two days; failing that, the assembly decides by absolute majority after hearing both sides

castigo.evidencia: Penalties: only for written rules, proportional, decided by the assembly after hearing the accused: warning, extra work, loss of surplus share, suspension from role.

salida.evidencia: Whoever leaves takes personal effects and a fair share of stored food, never medicines, tools or the boat.

principio_distributivo.evidencia: receives a full basic ration; surplus is distributed proportionally to work

medicamentos.evidencia: P2 medic, kit custodian, reports stock each assembly

bote.evidencia: Boat secured by custodian, leaves only by 5-of-7 decision with rower aboard; custodian may postpone for weather or safety, reporting to assembly.

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: Extraction follows quotas approved within three days, using Party 4's monthly written inventory, public and verifiable

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: land, water, trees, animals, mines and the river are common property; nobody may appropriate them. ... Personal effects are private.

proteccion_ambiental.evidencia: Extraction follows quotas approved within three days, using Party 4's monthly written inventory, public and verifiable ... Party 4 may suspend extraction below recovery level until assembly votes within two days
